title: Read a file
goal: Read a short policy and a lab log without opening an editor.

cheatSheet.description: Print a whole file. Fine for short notes, noisy for long logs.
Print the first 5 lines. The default is 10.
Print the last 20 lines. Useful on logs, not required in this lab.
Read a screen at a time. Space moves forward, b goes back, q quits.
Print two files, one after the other.

tasks.prompt: Print the whole policy in docs/policy.txt.
tasks.hint: cat prints a file from start to end. Pass the path.

checks.text: Do not share your lab login.

tasks.prompt: Show the first 5 lines of logs/auth.log.
tasks.hint: head -n 5 takes a count. head -5 is the same thing.

tasks.prompt: Show the first 12 lines of the same log.
tasks.hint: Change the count. The file is 12 lines, so this prints all of it.

tasks.prompt: Open logs/auth.log in less, then quit with q.
tasks.hint: less file opens the pager. q leaves it. The task marks when less starts cleanly.

tasks.prompt: Print the policy and the log in one command, policy first.
tasks.hint: cat accepts more than one file. They print in the order you write them.
